cohort: The study included women after their first spontaneous void post-vaginal delivery, categorized by their post-void residual volume (PVRV) into those with PVRV < 150 mL and those with PVRV >= 150 mL.
finding: Covert postpartum urinary retention (PVRV >= 150 mL) is a common and transient phenomenon that does not result in more lower urinary tract symptoms 1 year after delivery.
mod_finding: The study focused on women after vaginal delivery, concluding that covert PUR following this mode of birth does not lead to long-term micturition problems.
